evidence: Carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and adds the `sat_vb` argument to four fee-related RPC endpoints in src/rpc/.
rationale: Exposes feerates formatted in sat/vB across multiple RPC endpoints, directly resolving a recurring downstream pain point. As the PR notes, returning values exclusively in BTC/kvB has been 'very burdensome and is not good practice' for modern tooling (referencing #32093), and client-side conversion risks precision loss in sub-1 sat/vB conditions.
